\n <style id="ubgforever-inline-css">
:root { --bg-color: #0a0a0a; --card-bg: #141414; --accent-color: #2563eb; }
body { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; background-color: var(--bg-color); color: #ffffff; overflow-x: hidden; transition: background-color 0.3s ease; }
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-color); } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 9999px; }
#navbar { backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); z-index: 50; } .nav-at-top { background-color: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.85); } .nav-scrolled { background-color: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%); }
#top-nav-row { transition: max-height 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.25s ease, margin 0.25s ease; max-height: 64px; }
.no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .no-scrollbar { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; }
.tab-btn { transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); outline: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: none !important; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .tab-btn.inactive { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #a1a1aa; } .tab-btn.inactive:hover { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); color: #ffffff; } .tab-btn.active { background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); color: #ffffff; }
.text-shadow-strong { text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }
.umbrel-card { background-color: transparent; border: none; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .umbrel-card:hover { background-color: rgba(38, 40, 42, 0.8); }
.desc-12-lines { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 12; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 75%, transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 75%, transparent 100%); }
.loader { --dim: 3rem; width: var(--dim); height: var(--dim); position: relative; animation: spin988 2s linear infinite; }
.loader .circle { --color: #ffffff; --dim: 1.2rem; width: var(--dim); height: var(--dim); background-color: var(--color); border-radius: 50%; position: absolute; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); }
.loader .circle:nth-child(1) { top: 0; left: 0; } .loader .circle:nth-child(2) { top: 0; right: 0; } .loader .circle:nth-child(3) { bottom: 0; left: 0; } .loader .circle:nth-child(4) { bottom: 0; right: 0; }
@keyframes spin988 { 0% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); } 20%, 25% { transform: scale(1.3) rotate(90deg); } 45%, 50% { transform: scale(1) rotate(180deg); } 70%, 75% { transform: scale(1.3) rotate(270deg); } 95%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(360deg); } }
.player-spinner { width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-left-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.tooltip-box { position: relative; } .tooltip-bubble { position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px); margin-top: 8px; background-color: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); z-index: 60; }
.sidebar-tooltip { position: absolute; left: 100%; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(6px); margin-left: 8px; background-color: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); z-index: 60; }
.sidebar-tooltip::before { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 100%; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); border-width: 5px; border-style: solid; border-color: transparent rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.95) transparent transparent; }
.tooltip-box:hover .sidebar-tooltip { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(10px); }
.tooltip-bubble::before { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); border-width: 5px; border-style: solid; border-color: transparent transparent rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.95) transparent; }
.tooltip-box:hover .tooltip-bubble { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); }
:fullscreen #player-topnav, :-webkit-full-screen #player-topnav { display: none !important; }
:fullscreen #player-frame-container, :-webkit-full-screen #player-frame-container { position: fixed !important; inset: 0 !important; width: 100vw !important; height: 100vh !important; z-index: 99999 !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; }
.view-section { padding-top: 24px; padding-bottom: 100px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .view-section { padding-top: 160px; padding-bottom: 40px; } }
.mobile-search-closed { max-width: 0px; opacity: 0; padding: 0; pointer-events: none; } .mobile-search-open { max-width: 100%; opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.slide-dot-btn { outline: none !important; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .slide-dot-btn .progress-fill { transition: width 0.1s linear; }
.setting-btn-top { border-top-left-radius: 1.25rem; border-top-right-radius: 1.25rem; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; } .setting-btn-bottom { border-bottom-left-radius: 1.25rem; border-bottom-right-radius: 1.25rem; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; } .setting-btn-single { border-radius: 1.25rem; }
.theme-circle { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .theme-circle:hover { transform: scale(1.1); } .theme-circle.active-theme { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffffff; }
.safe-game-grid{margin-top:28px;} .safe-game-section{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border-radius:24px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.2);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);} .safe-game-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px;} .safe-game-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:60px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);color:#fff;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;} .safe-game-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:rgba(99,102,241,.16);border-color:rgba(129,140,248,.45);} .safe-game-icon{font-size:24px}.safe-game-name{font-weight:800;flex:1}.safe-game-arrow{font-size:24px;color:#a5b4fc}.safe-game-empty{padding:30px;color:#a1a1aa;text-align:center;} .safe-game-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;display:none;background:#050507;} .safe-game-modal.open{display:flex;flex-direction:column;} .safe-game-modal-bar{height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:0 14px;background:rgba(10,10,15,.95);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;font-weight:800;} .safe-game-modal-bar button{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;} #safe-game-frame{width:100%;height:calc(100vh - 56px);border:0;background:#000;}

body{background:var(--ubg-bg)!important;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 0%,rgba(56,189,248,.09),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 88% 22%,rgba(139,92,246,.10),transparent <script> (function () { const KEY = 'ubgforever_repo_state_v1'; const defaults = { profile: { name: 'Player', bio: 'Ready to play.', level: 1, xp: 0, streak: 0 }, favorites: [], history: [], collections: [], friends: [], activity: [], requests: [], achievements: [], settings: { compact: false, reducedMotion: false, dynamicBg: true, accent: 'violet' }, lastVisit: null }; function clone(v){ return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)); } function load(){ try { const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY); return raw ? Object.assign(clone(defaults), JSON.parse(raw)) : clone(defaults); } catch(e){ return clone(defaults); } } let state=load(); function save(){ try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch(e){}; window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ubgstatechange',{detail:state})); } window.UBGStore={ get(){ return state; }, save, reset(){ state=clone(defaults); save(); return state; }, patch(part, value){ state[part]=value; save(); return state[part]; }, addHistory(name){ if(!name)return; state.history=[{name,time:Date.now()},...state.history.filter(x=>x.name!==name)].slice(0,30); state.profile.xp += 10; state.profile.level=1+Math.floor(state.profile.xp/250); save(); }, toggleFavorite(name){ const i=state.favorites.indexOf(name); if(i>=0) state.favorites.splice(i,1); else state.favorites.push(name); save(); return !~i; }, addCollection(name){ if(name && !state.collections.includes(name)) state.collections.push(name); save(); }, addActivity(text){ state.activity=[{text,time:Date.now()},...state.activity].slice(0,50); save(); }, export(){ return JSON.stringify(state,null,2); }, import(raw){ const parsed=JSON.parse(raw); state=Object.assign(clone(defaults),parsed); save(); return state; }, key:KEY }; })();
</script>

function generateAppCardHTML(app) { return ` <div onclick="openAppDetails('${app.id}')" class="group umbrel-card flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4 p-3 sm:p-3.5 rounded-[20px] sm:rounded-[24px] cursor-pointer hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-200"> <div class="w-14 h-14 sm:w-16 sm:h-16 md:w-20 md:h-20 rounded-[18px] sm:rounded-[22px] overflow-hidden shrink-0 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105 shadow-lg bg-white/5 relative"> <img src="${app.img || ''}" loading="lazy" class="w-full h-full object-cover" alt="${app.name || 'App'}" /> </div> <div class="flex flex-col justify-center min-w-0 flex-1"> <div class="flex items-center gap-2"> <h3 class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm md:text-base text-white truncate group-hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">${app.name || 'Untitled App'}</h3> </div> <p class="text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] md:text-xs text-gray-300 font-normal mt-1 leading-snug line-clamp-2">${app.description || ''}</p> </div> </div> `; }

const banner = document.getElementById('hero-banner-section'); const slideshow = document.getElementById('slideshow-section'); const hotNow = document.getElementById('serving-hot-section'); const grid = document.getElementById('all-apps-grid'); const categoryLoader = document.getElementById('category-loader');

currentSortedApps = cat === 'All' ? function renderServingHotNow() { const grid = document.getElementById('serving-hot-grid'); if (!grid) return; if (storeApps.length === 0) { grid.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 col-span-full py-4 text-center">No apps currently available.</p>'; return; } const top7 = [...storeApps].sort(function(a, b) { return (b.downloads || 0) - (a.downloads || 0); }).slice(0, 7); grid.innerHTML = top7.map(function(app) { return ` <div onclick="openAppDetails('${app.id}')" class="flex flex-col items-center cursor-pointer group"> <div class="w-full aspect-square rounded-[18px] sm:rounded-[24px] overflow-hidden shrink-0 shadow-md group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200 bg-white/5"> <img src="${app.img || ''}" loading="lazy" class="w-full h-full object-cover" alt="${app.name || ''}"> </div> <div class="mt-2 text-center w-full px-1"> <h3 class="font-bold text-[11px] sm:text-xs md:text-sm text-white truncate group-hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">${app.name || ''}</h3> </div> </div> `; }).join(''); }
function renderAllAppsGrid() { const grid = document.getElementById('all-apps-grid'); const endText = document.getElementById('end-feed-text'); if (!grid) return; if (currentSortedApps.length === 0) { grid.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 col-span-full py-8 text-center">No apps found for this category.</p>'; if (endText) endText.classList.add('hidden'); return; } grid.innerHTML = currentSortedApps.slice(0, displayedCount).map(generateAppCardHTML).join(''); if (endText) { if (displayedCount >= currentSortedApps.length) endText.classList.remove('hidden'); else endText.classList.add('hidden'); } }
function handleSortChange(sortType) { currentSortedApps = [...storeApps]; if (sortType === 'alphabetical') { currentSortedApps.sort(function(a, b) { return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''); }); } else if (sortType === 'downloads') { currentSortedApps.sort(function(a, b) { return (b.downloads || 0) - (a.downloads || 0); }); } else if (sortType === 'likes') { currentSortedApps.sort(function(a, b) { return (b.likes || 0) - (a.likes || 0); }); } else if (sortType === 'newest') { currentSortedApps.sort(function(a, b) { return new Date(b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.created_at || 0); }); } displayedCount = 10; renderAllAppsGrid(); }
window.addEventListener('scroll', function() { const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar'); const topNavRow = document.getElementById('top-nav-row'); const heroImg = null;
if (window.scrollY > 20) { if (topNavRow) { topNavRow.style.maxHeight = '0px'; topNavRow.style.opacity = '0'; topNavRow.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; topNavRow.style.margin = '0'; } if (navbar) { navbar.classList.remove('nav-at-top'); navbar.classList.add('nav-scrolled'); } } else { if (topNavRow) { topNavRow.style.maxHeight = '64px'; topNavRow.style.opacity = '1'; topNavRow.style.pointerEvents = 'auto'; topNavRow.style.margin = ''; } if (navbar) { navbar.classList.remove('nav-scrolled'); navbar.classList.add('nav-at-top'); } }
if (heroImg && document.getElementById('home-page-view') && !document.getElementById('home-page-view').classList.contains('hidden')) { heroImg.style.transform = `scale(${Math.max(1.0, 1.15 - (window.scrollY / 1200))})`; }
const homeView = document.getElementById('home-page-view'); if (homeView && !homeView.classList.contains('hidden')) { if ((window.innerHeight + window.scrollY) >= document.body.offsetHeight - 220) { if (displayedCount < currentSortedApps.length) { displayedCount += 10; renderAllAppsGrid(); } } } });
function initSlideshowDots() { const track = document.getElementById('slideshow-track'); const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('dots-container'); if (!track || !dotsContainer) return; const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.carousel-card'); if (cards.length > 0) { dotsContainer.innerHTML = Array.from(cards).map(function(_, i) { return ` <button onclick="manualSlideSelect(${i})" class="slide-dot-btn relative h-2 sm:h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer ${i === 0 ? 'w-8 sm:w-10 active-dot' : 'w-2 sm:w-2.5'}"> <div class="progress-fill absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-white rounded-full w-0"></div> </button> `; }).join(''); } resetSlideTimer(); }
function resetSlideTimer() { clearInterval(slideTimer); const activeFill = document.querySelector('.slide-dot-btn.active-dot .progress-fill'); if (activeFill) { activeFill.style.transition = 'none'; activeFill.style.width = '0%'; setTimeout(function() { activeFill.style.transition = `width ${SLIDE_DURATION}ms linear`; activeFill.style.width = '100%'; }, 50); } slideTimer = setInterval(nextSlide, SLIDE_DURATION); }
function scrollToSlide(index) { const track = document.getElementById('slideshow-track'); if (!track) return; const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.carousel-card'); if (!cards.length) return; currentSlideIndex = (index + cards.length) % cards.length; track.scrollTo({ left: cards[currentSlideIndex].offsetLeft - track.offsetLeft, behavior: 'smooth' }); document.querySelectorAll('.slide-dot-btn').forEach(function(dot, idx) { const fill = dot.querySelector('.progress-fill'); if (idx === currentSlideIndex) { dot.className = 'slide-dot-btn active-dot relative h-2 sm:h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer w-8 sm:w-10'; if (fill) fill.style.width = '0%'; } else { dot.className = 'slide-dot-btn relative h-2 sm:h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer w-2 sm:w-2.5'; if (fill) fill.style.width = '0%'; } }); }
function manualSlideSelect(i) { scrollToSlide(i); resetSlideTimer(); } function nextSlide() { scrollToSlide(currentSlideIndex + 1); resetSlideTimer(); } function prevSlide() { scrollToSlide(currentSlideIndex - 1); resetSlideTimer(); }
function calculateAppSearchScore(app, cleanQuery) { if (!cleanQuery) return 0; let score = 0; const name = (app.name || '').toLowerCase(); const cat = (app.category || '').toLowerCase(); const desc = (app.description || '').toLowerCase(); const dev = (app.developer || '').toLowerCase();
if (name === cleanQuery) score += 100; else if (name.startsWith(cleanQuery)) score += 60; else if (name.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 40;
if (cat.includes(cleanQuery)) score += 30;
const tokens = cleanQuery.split(/\s+/); tokens.forEach(token => { if (token.length > 1) { if (name.includes(token)) score += 15; if (cat.includes(token)) score += 10; if (dev.includes(token)) score += 8; if (desc.includes(token)) score += 5; } });
return score; }
function performAdvancedSearch(query) { const clean = query.toLowerCase().trim(); if (!clean) return [];
const scoredApps = storeApps.map(function(app) { return { app: app, score: calculateAppSearchScore(app, clean) }; }).filter(function(item) { return item.score > 0; });
scoredApps.sort(function(a, b) { return b.score - a.score; }); return scoredApps.map(function(item) { return item.app; }); }
function onSearchInputChange(value) { const desktopClear = document.getElementById('search-clear-btn'); const mobileClear = document.getElementById('mobile-search-clear-btn');
if (value.trim().length > 0) { if (desktopClear) desktopClear.classList.remove('hidden'); if (mobileClear) mobileClear.classList.remove('hidden'); handleSearchSuggestions(value); } else { if (desktopClear) desktopClear.classList.add('hidden'); if (mobileClear) mobileClear.classList.add('hidden'); hideSearchSuggestions(); } }
function clearSearchInput() { const desktopInput = document.getElementById('search-input'); const mobileInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input'); const desktopClear = document.getElementById('search-clear-btn'); const mobileClear = document.getElementById('mobile-search-clear-btn');
if (desktopInput) desktopInput.value = ''; if (mobileInput) mobileInput.value = ''; if (desktopClear) desktopClear.classList.add('hidden'); if (mobileClear) mobileClear.classList.add('hidden'); hideSearchSuggestions(); }
function handleSearchSuggestions(query) { const popup = document.getElementById('search-suggestions'); if (!popup) return;
const matches = performAdvancedSearch(query).slice(0, 5);
if (matches.length === 0) { popup.classList.add('hidden'); popup.innerHTML = ''; return; } popup.innerHTML = matches.map(function(app) { return ` <div onclick="openAppDetails('${app.id}'); hideSearchSuggestions();" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-colors"> <img src="${app.img || ''}" loading="lazy" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg object-cover bg-white/5 shrink-0" /> <div class="min-w-0 flex-1"> <h4 class="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">${app.name || ''}</h4> </div> </div> `; }).join(''); popup.classList.remove('hidden'); }
function hideSearchSuggestions() { const popup = document.getElementById('search-suggestions'); if (popup) popup.classList.add('hidden'); }
function handleSearch(e) { if (e) e.preventDefault(); const desktopInput = document.getElementById('search-input'); const mobileInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input'); const query = ((desktopInput && desktopInput.value) || (mobileInput && mobileInput.value) || '').toLowerCase().trim(); if (!query) return; executeSearch(query, true); }
function executeSearch(query, updateHash = true) { hideSearchSuggestions(); if (updateHash) window.location.hash = `search/${encodeURIComponent(query)}`;
const queryDisplay = document.getElementById('search-query-display'); if (queryDisplay) queryDisplay.innerText = query;
const grid = document.getElementById('search-results-grid'); const emptyState = document.getElementById('search-empty-state'); const loader = document.getElementById('search-loader');
if (grid) grid.classList.add('hidden'); if (emptyState) emptyState.classList.add('hidden'); if (loader) loader.classList.remove('hidden');
showView('search-page-view');
setTimeout(function() { const results = performAdvancedSearch(query); if (loader) loader.classList.add('hidden');
if (results.length > 0) { if (grid) { grid.innerHTML = results.map(generateAppCardHTML).join(''); grid.classList.remove('hidden'); } if (emptyState) emptyState.classList.add('hidden'); } else { if (grid) { grid.innerHTML = ''; grid.classList.add('hidden'); } if (emptyState) emptyState.classList.remove('hidden'); } }, 300); }
async function openAppDetails(appId, updateHash = true) { const app = storeApps.find(function(a) { return String(a.id) === String(appId); }); if (!app) return; currentDetailedApp = app;
if (updateHash) window.location.hash = `app/${app.id}`;
const detailImg = document.getElementById('detail-app-img'); if (detailImg) detailImg.src = app.img || ''; const detailTitle = document.getElementById('detail-app-title'); if (detailTitle) detailTitle.textContent = app.name || '';
const statDl = document.getElementById('detail-stat-downloads'); if (statDl) statDl.textContent = app.downloads !== undefined ? Number(app.downloads).toLocaleString() : '—'; const statSize = document.getElementById('detail-stat-filesize'); if (statSize) statSize.textContent = app.file_size || '—'; const statCat = document.getElementById('detail-stat-category'); if (statCat) statCat.textContent = app.category || '—'; const statDev = document.getElementById('detail-stat-developer'); if (statDev) statDev.textContent = app.developer || '—'; const statSub = document.getElementById('detail-stat-submittedby'); if (statSub) statSub.textContent = app.submitted_by || '—';
const descContent = document.getElementById('detail-desc-content'); const descWrapper = document.getElementById('detail-desc-wrapper'); const descBtn = document.getElementById('detail-desc-btn'); if (descContent && descWrapper && descBtn) { descContent.innerHTML = app.description || ''; descWrapper.classList.add('desc-12-lines'); descBtn.textContent = 'Read more'; setTimeout(function() { if (descContent.scrollHeight > descWrapper.clientHeight) { descBtn.classList.remove('hidden'); } else { descBtn.classList.add('hidden'); descWrapper.classList.remove('desc-12-lines'); } }, 60); }
const tlContainer = document.getElementById('versions-timeline-container'); if (tlContainer) { tlContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="absolute left-2.5 top-3 bottom-3 w-[2px] bg-white/10 pointer-events-none"></div>'; let versions = []; if (supabaseClient) { try { const res = await supabaseClient.from('app_versions').select('*').eq('app_id', app.id).order('release_date', { ascending: false }); if (res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
const seenVersions = new Set(); versions = res.data.filter(v => { const key = v.version_name || v.id; if (seenVersions.has(key)) return false; seenVersions.add(key); return true; }); } } catch (e) {} }
if (versions.length > 0) { versions.forEach(function(ver, index) { const isLatest = index === 0; const dot = isLatest ? `<div class="absolute -left-[23px] top-1.5 flex items-center justify-center"> <span class="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full bg-white opacity-75"></span> <span class="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-white shadow-[0_0_12px_#ffffff]"></span> </div>` : `<div class="absolute -left-[20px] top-1.5 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white/30"></div>`;
tlContainer.innerHTML += ` <div class="relative transition-all"> ${dot} <div class="flex items-center justify-between"> <button onclick="toggleVersionNotes('ver-${ver.id || index}')" class="font-bold text-base text-white hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left"> ${ver.version_name || ''} </button> <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">${ver.release_date ? new Date(ver.release_date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {month:'short', year:'numeric'}) : ''}</span> </div> <div id="notes-ver-${ver.id || index}" class="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-300 font-normal leading-relaxed hidden"> ${ver.changelog || ''} </div> </div> `; }); } else { tlContainer.innerHTML = ''; } }
const relatedGrid = document.getElementById('related-apps-grid'); if (relatedGrid) { const relatedApps = storeApps.filter(function(x) { return x.category === app.category && String(x.id) !== String(app.id); }).slice(0, 3); if (relatedApps.length > 0) { relatedGrid.innerHTML = relatedApps.map(generateAppCardHTML).join(''); } else { relatedGrid.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 w-full col-span-full">No related apps found.</p>'; } }
showView('app-details-view'); }

if (loaderOverlay) { loaderOverlay.classList.remove('hidden'); loaderOverlay.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); }

function closeAppPlayer() { const playerIframe = document.getElementById('player-iframe');
if (settingsState.ramOpt && playerIframe) { playerIframe.src = 'about:blank'; playerIframe.removeAttribute('srcdoc'); }
if (document.fullscreenElement) { document.exitFullscreen().catch(function() {}); } if (currentDetailedApp) { window.location.hash = `app/${currentDetailedApp.id}`; showView('app-details-view'); } else { window.location.hash = 'home'; showView('home-page-view'); } }
function openInNewTab() { if (!currentDetailedApp || !currentDetailedApp.app_url) return; window.open(currentDetailedApp.app_url, '_blank'); }
function downloadCurrentApp() { if (!currentDetailedApp) return; const downloadTarget = currentDetailedApp.download_url || currentDetailedApp.app_url; if (!downloadTarget) return; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = downloadTarget; a.download = currentDetailedApp.name || 'download'; a.target = '_blank'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a); }
function togglePlayerFullscreen() { const frameContainer = document.getElementById('player-frame-container'); const targetElement = frameContainer || document.getElementById('app-player-view'); if (!targetElement) return;
if (!document.fullscreenElement) { targetElement.requestFullscreen().catch(function(err) { console.error(err); }); } else { document.exitFullscreen().catch(function(err) { console.error(err); }); } }
function toggleDescription() { const descWrapper = document.getElementById('detail-desc-wrapper'); const descBtn = document.getElementById('detail-desc-btn'); if (descWrapper && descBtn) { if (descWrapper.classList.contains('desc-12-lines')) { descWrapper.classList.remove('desc-12-lines'); descBtn.textContent = 'Read less'; } else { descWrapper.classList.add('desc-12-lines'); descBtn.textContent = 'Read more'; } } }
function toggleVersionNotes(verKey) { const notes = document.getElementById(`notes-${verKey}`); if (notes) notes.classList.toggle('hidden'); }
let isMobileSearchOpen = false; function toggleMobileSearch() { const categoryBar = document.getElementById('mobile-category-bar'); const searchWrapper = document.getElementById('mobile-search-wrapper'); const searchIcon = document.getElementById('mobile-search-icon'); const searchInput = document.getElementById('mobile-search-input');
isMobileSearchOpen = !isMobileSearchOpen;
if (isMobileSearchOpen) { categoryBar.classList.add('max-w-0', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); searchWrapper.classList.remove('mobile-search-closed'); searchWrapper.classList.add('mobile-search-open'); if (searchIcon) searchIcon.style.transform = 'rotate(90deg)'; setTimeout(function() { if (searchInput) searchInput.focus(); }, 150); } else { categoryBar.classList.remove('max-w-0', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none'); searchWrapper.classList.remove('mobile-search-open'); searchWrapper.classList.add('mobile-search-closed'); if (searchIcon) searchIcon.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'; } }

(function(){ window.eduSearch=function(){ var input=document.getElementById('edu-search-input'); if(!input)return; var q=input.value.trim(); if(q){window.open('https://www.google.com/search?q='+encodeURIComponent(q),'_blank','noopener');} }; var input=document.getElementById('edu-search-input'); if(input){input.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();window.eduSearch();}});} })();

<script> (function(){ 'use strict'; const {escapeHtml,formatTime,toast,findGameName}=window.UBGUI; const store=window.UBGStore; const state=()=>store.get();
const css=` #command-center-page-view{display:none;padding:28px 24px 60px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;} #command-center-page-view.active{display:block;} .cc-card{padding:13px}.ubg-dynamic-bg{background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 15%,rgba(124,58,237,.12),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%,rgba(37,99,235,.08),transparent 30%)}.ubg-feature-toast{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:9999;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:12px;background:#171717;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 12px function inject(){ const wrapper=document.getElementById('page-wrapper') || document.body; const nav=document.getElementById('category-nav'); if(nav && !document.getElementById('command-center-nav')){ const b=document.createElement('button'); b.id='command-center-nav'; b.type='button'; b.className='tab-btn'; b.innerHTML='<span>✦</span> Command Center'; nav.appendChild(b); b.addEventListener('click',()=>open()); } const page=document.createElement('section'); page.id='command-center-page-view'; page.innerHTML=`<div class="cc-head"><div><div class="cc-title">Command Center</div><div class="cc-sub">Your profile, activity, collections, challenges, customization, and site tools.</div></div><button class="cc-btn" id="cc-back">← Back to Hub</button></div> <div class="cc-tabs">${['Overview','Profile','Library','Social','Challenges','Customize','Tools','Updates'].map((x,i)=>`<button class="cc-tab ${i===0?'active':''}" data-panel="${x.toLowerCase()}">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div> <div id="cc-overview" class="cc-panel active"></div><div id="cc-profile" class="cc-panel"></div><div id="cc-library" class="cc-panel"></div><div id="cc-social" class="cc-panel"></div><div id="cc-challenges" class="cc-panel"></div><div id="cc-customize" class="cc-panel"></div><div id="cc-tools" class="cc-panel"></div><div id="cc-updates" class="cc-panel"></div>`; wrapper.appendChild(page); page.querySelector('#cc-back').addEventListener('click',()=>close()); page.querySelectorAll('.cc-tab').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{page.querySelectorAll('.cc-tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));page.querySelectorAll('.cc-panel').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));btn.classList.add('active');document.getElementById('cc-'+btn.dataset.panel).classList.add('active');})); renderAll(); } function open(){ document.querySelectorAll('#page-wrapper > div, #page-wrapper > section').forEach(x=>{if(x.id!=='command-center-page-view') x.style.display='none';}); const p=document.getElementById('command-center-page-view'); if(p){p.classList.add('active');window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});} renderAll(); } function close(){ const p=document.getElementById('command-center-page-view'); if(p)p.classList.remove('active'); function renderAll(){renderOverview();renderProfile();renderLibrary();renderSocial();renderChallenges();renderCustomize();renderTools();renderUpdates();applySettings();} function renderOverview(){const s=state(), el=document.getElementById('cc-overview'); if(!el)return; const fav=s.favorites.length, hist=s.history.length, xp=s.profile.xp||0, level=s.profile.level||1, progress=(xp%250)/250*100; el.innerHTML=`<div class="cc-grid"><div class="cc-card"><span class="cc-pill">LEVEL ${level}</span><div class="cc-stat">${xp} XP</div><div class="cc-meter"><span style="width:${progress}%"></span></div><p>${250-(xp%250)} XP until the next level.</p></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Favorites</h3><div class="cc-stat">${fav}</div><p>Games you marked to revisit.</p></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Play History</h3><div class="cc-stat">${hist}</div><p>Recent games tracked locally.</p></div><div class="cc-card cc-wide"><h3>Recommendations</h3><div class="cc-list">${recommendations().map(n=>`<div class="cc-row"><span>${escapeHtml(n)}</span><span class="cc-pill">Suggested</span></div>`).join('')||'<p>No recommendations yet. Keep playing to increase mastery.`:'Start playing to build mastery levels.';} function renderProfile(){const s=state(),el=document.getElementById('cc-profile'); if(!el)return; el.innerHTML=`<div class="cc-grid"><div class="cc-card cc-wide"><h3>Player Profile</h3><div class="cc-list"><label>Name<input class="cc-input" id="cc-name" value="${escapeHtml(s.profile.name)}"></label><label>Bio<input class="cc-input" id="cc-bio" value="${escapeHtml(s.profile.bio)}"></label></div><div class="cc-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="cc-btn primary" id="save-profile">Save el.querySelector('#save-profile').onclick=()=>{s.profile.name=el.querySelector('#cc-name').value.trim()||'Player';s.profile.bio=el.querySelector('#cc-bio').value.trim();store.save();toast('Profile class="cc-row"><span>${escapeHtml(n)}</span><button class="cc-btn" data-remove="${escapeHtml(n)}">Remove</button></div>`).join('')||'<p>No favorites yet.</p>'}</div></div><div class="cc-card cc-wide"><h3>Recent History</h3><div class="cc-list">${s.history.slice(0,12).map(x=>`<div class="cc-row"><span>${escapeHtml(x.name)}</span><small>${formatTime(x.time)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<p>No ${s.settings.reducedMotion?'checked':''}> Reduced motion</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="set-bg" ${s.settings.dynamicBg?'checked':''}> Dynamic background</label></div></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Theme Sharing</h3><p>Export your current settings and share the JSON with another UBGForever install.</p><button class="cc-btn" id="export-theme">Export Theme</button><input type="file" id="import-theme" accept="application/json" style="display:none"><button class="cc-btn" id="import-theme-btn">Import Theme</button></div></div>`; el.querySelectorAll('[data-accent]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{s.settings.accent=b.dataset.accent;store.save();applySettings();toast('Accent updated');}); el.querySelector('#set-compact').onchange=e=>{s.settings.compact=e.target.checked;store.save();applySettings();};el.querySelector('#set-motion').onchange=e=>{s.settings.reducedMotion=e.target.checked;store.save();applySettings();};el.querySelector('#set-bg').onchange=e=>{s.settings.dynamicBg=e.target.checked;store.save();applySettings();}; el.querySelector('#export-theme').onclick=()=>download('ubg-theme.json',JSON.stringify(s.settings,null,2),'application/json');el.querySelector('#import-theme-btn').onclick=()=>el.querySelector('#import-theme').click();el.querySelector('#import-theme').onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{s.settings=Object.assign(s.settings,JSON.parse(r.result));store.save();applySettings();renderCustomize();toast('Theme imported');}catch(_){toast('Invalid theme file');}};r.readAsText(f);}; } function applySettings(){const s=state();document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ubg-feature-accent',({violet:'#7c3aed',blue:'#2563eb',green:'#16a34a',orange:'#ea580c'}[s.settings.accent]||'#7c3aed'));document.body.classList.toggle('ubg-compact-mode',!!s.settings.compact);document.body.classList.toggle('ubg-dynamic-bg',!!s.settings.dynamicBg);document.documentElement.classList.toggle('reduce-motion',!!s.settings.reducedMotion);} function renderTools(){const el=document.getElementById('cc-tools');if(!el)return;const storage=(()=>{try{return JSON.stringify(localStorage).length}catch(_){return 0}})();el.innerHTML=`<div class="cc-grid"><div class="cc-card"><h3>Diagnostics</h3><p>Browser: ${escapeHtml(navigator.userAgent)}</p><p>Viewport: ${innerWidth} × ${innerHeight}</p><p>Storage: ${(storage/1024).toFixed(1)} KB used by accessible local storage.</p><button class="cc-btn" id="run-diagnostics">Run Check</button></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Performance</h3><p>Run a short client-side rendering benchmark.</p><button class="cc-btn" id="perf-test">Run Performance Test</button><div id="perf-result"></div></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Data</h3><p>Back up or restore your local UBGForever profile.</p><div class="cc-actions"><button class="cc-btn" id="export-data">Export Data</button><button class="cc-btn" id="import-data-btn">Import Data</button><input id="import-data" type="file" accept="application/json" style="display:none"></div></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Game Requests</h3><input class="cc-input" id="game-request" placeholder="Game you'd like added"><button class="cc-btn primary" id="submit-request" style="margin-top:8px">Submit Request</button></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>Reset</h3><p>Clear only UBGForever's local profile data. This does not delete files from the repository.</p><button class="cc-btn danger" id="reset-data">Reset Local Data</button></div></div>`; el.querySelector('#run-diagnostics').onclick=()=>toast('Diagnostics passed: core browser APIs available.');el.querySelector('#perf-test').onclick=()=>{const start=performance.now();let n=0;for(let i=0;i<300000;i++)n+=Math.sqrt(i);const ms=performance.now()-start;el.querySelector('#perf-result').innerHTML=`<p>Benchmark: ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms.</p>`;};el.querySelector('#export-data').onclick=()=>download('ubgforever-data.json',store.export(),'application/json');el.querySelector('#import-data-btn').onclick=()=>el.querySelector('#import-data').click();el.querySelector('#import-data').onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{store.import(r.result);renderAll();toast('Data imported');}catch(_){toast('Invalid backup file');}};r.readAsText(f);};el.querySelector('#submit-request').onclick=()=>{const v=el.querySelector('#game-request').value.trim();if(v){const s=state();s.requests.push({name:v,time:Date.now()});store.addActivity(`Requested game: ${v}`);store.save();el.querySelector('#game-request').value='';toast('Request saved locally');}};el.querySelector('#reset-data').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Reset your local UBGForever data?')){store.reset();renderAll();toast('Local data reset');}}; } function renderUpdates(){const el=document.getElementById('cc-updates');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=`<div class="cc-grid"><div class="cc-card cc-wide"><h3>Changelog</h3><div class="cc-list"><div class="cc-row"><span>Command Center</span><span class="cc-pill">New</span></div><div class="cc-row"><span>Profiles, XP, achievements and streak tracking</span><span class="cc-pill">New</span></div><div class="cc-row"><span>Favorites, history and collections</span><span class="cc-pill">New</span></div><div class="cc-row"><span>Theme Studio and data backup</span><span class="cc-pill">New</span></div></div></div><div class="cc-card"><h3>About</h3><p>UBGForever is organized into small modules so future features can be added without turning index.html into one giant file.</p></div></div>`;} function download(name,data,type){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type}));a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),500);}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const card=e.target.closest('.safe-game-card');if(card){const name=findGameName(card);if(name){store.addHistory(name);store.addActivity(`Played ${name}`);}}}); window.addEventListener('ubgstatechange',()=>{if(document.getElementById('command-center-page-view')?.classList.contains('active'))renderAll();}); document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{inject();}); })();
</script></body> </html>
